title: Portal Chats: the red numbers clear in every open window once a message is read
text: A page left open used to keep the red dot of a client message that someone had already read in another window. On the Portal Chats page the number in the left menu never changed at all, and the conversation list took about a minute. Now when a message is read, every other open window updates within a few seconds. A window that was left in the background also refreshes the moment you come back to it.
points: Open Portal Chats in two windows, read a client message in one: the red number in the other drops within seconds
The conversation list dot also clears within seconds
Switch back to a window you left for a while: its numbers refresh at once
